settings.title: Car name
settings.description: The name the iPhone app shows for this car.

settings.title: Only in Park
settings.description: The phone can change the ambient light only while the car is in P. Letting go of the light always works.

settings.title: Ambient light from the phone at start
settings.description: Each time the head unit starts, put on the colour and brightness last saved from the phone. Needs Custom colour in the car's mood-lamp settings.

settings.title: Saved ambient colour
settings.description: 6 hex digits (rrggbb), set from the phone. Empty: none saved.
